title: Coupled lateral-bending and axial-rotation moments at L5/S1 during 20-80% MVC extension ramps (upright), males
condition: static extension ramp contractions 0-100% MVC with visual feedback of extension moment only (1D), upright standing

quantity.name: L5/S1 moments during extension effort
quantity.definition: Mext, |Mlat| and |Mrot| at L5/S1 at 20/40/60/80% of extension MVC, averaged over three ramp trials; lateral and axial values converted to absolute values before averaging

source.authors: Lariviere C, Gagnon D, Gravel D, Arsenault AB, Dumas JP, Goyette M, Loisel P
source.sample: healthy males, no back problem in preceding 6 months, in vivo

protocol.summary: Static triaxial dynamometer: subject stands erect, knees held in extension (pad), feet stabilised by wooden blocks, pelvis stabilised by a sacral pad and two pads over the ASIS; force platform (AMTI MC6-6-1000) at shoulder level contacted by an upper-back pad; trunk assumed vertical; moments computed at the L5/S1 joint centre (located from ASIS/PSIS: 50% of ASIS-PSIS distance from PSIS, 15 mm above). Three 7-s ramp contractions (0-100% MVC) following a moving target with a 10% tolerance band; 90 s rest.
how_to_simulate: Upright standing, pelvis fixed, trunk vertical.
Apply extension moments of 51.5, 101.7, 152.1, 202.0 Nm at L5/S1 via an upper-back (shoulder-level) contact.

If the model predicts out-of-plane moments (e.g. with asymmetric muscle recruitment or contact), compare |lateral| and |axial| L5/S1 moments with data; otherwise use as the coupled-moment envelope (tolerance mean+2SD given in paper).
protocol.notes: Coupled moments are absolute (unsigned) values - not comparable to signed means (e.g. Ghezelbash 2018). Paper's tolerance limits (mean+2SD): lateral 2.7/5.3/9.5/19.4 Nm, axial 1.7/3.6/8.9/15.2 Nm.

extraction.check_notes: Table 1 re-read; 80% values match abstract (6.2±6.6, 6.1±4.5); mean+2SD reproduces paper's tolerance limits within rounding.
